name: release-flow
description: Check the layout, run the tests, bump the version, tag the commit, build artifacts and roll back when tagging fails.

steps.description: Validate packaging metadata and the test layout before touching the version.
Run the full test suite on the candidate commit.
Write the new version into every file that declares it.
Create the annotated git tag for the bumped version.
Build the wheel and sdist from the tagged commit.
Undo the version bump when tagging fails.
